symptom: A Data grid 2 custom-content column written with `Caption: ''` (or no caption) through the generic `pluggablewidget 'com.mendix.widget.web.datagrid.Datagrid'` path showed its MDL column name (`colTriage`) as the header to end users; mx check, check and lint all passed.
cause: applyColumnHeaderFallback filled an empty header on an attribute-less column with the column's NAME, a name Mendix does not store for a column. It was written on the belief that an empty header is CE0463; that CE0463 was a null TextTemplate, and the empty Forms$ClientTemplate (ChipCoV8 #11) builds clean. The keyword `datagrid` path already wrote the empty header.
insight: Read the widget's own bundle before reasoning about a render: Datagrid.mjs renders `header.trim() || ' '`, so no runtime fallback exists and the text had to come from the writer. Grepping the stored unit for the name settled which path wrote it. A CE0463 'fix' that substitutes a value should be re-measured once the null-vs-empty shape is known; this one outlived the shape fix by three months. Separately: create or replace does not clear a column caption to '' on either path (Unchanged page), so an app already holding the name needs the page dropped and recreated.
